Zero-shot · evaluated on 89 images

Evaluated on the full train split (89 images): it is within the 500-image sampling cap, so no subsampling was applied. Grounding DINO detection prompt: the dataset's category names, lowercased and joined into a single caption "name1. name2. ..."; each box's score for a label is the max sigmoid score over that label's caption tokens. No score threshold is applied: every predicted box is a candidate for every label, and the top 100 boxes per label per image are kept. mAP is COCO-style mAP averaged over IoU 0.50:0.95 and mAP50 is AP at IoU 0.50 (torchmetrics MeanAveragePrecision, bbox).

The box_2d coordinates are [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max], normalized to 0-1000.'. Generation sampling params (vLLM): {'temperature': 1.0, 'top_p': 0.95, 'top_k': 64}, max_tokens=2048, batch_size=32.
